decision: ACCEPT observed four-run rendering-cost budget; no causal speedup claim
method: Retain all four fresh-browser runs per arm and viewport. Baseline has fast and 16 ms timing modes; candidate only has the fast mode. Compare fast-mode medians and, more conservatively, every candidate run against the fastest baseline run. Use lowest baseline draw count against highest candidate count. These observed ratios are below 15%; unmatched slow baseline samples do not establish an improvement.
limitations: Four runs per arm are bounded local observations; they do not establish device-wide performance or guarantee the absence of rare slower candidate modes.
